Alex: Quick random pool — Over/Under 7 total goals for Rapids vs Cosmos on Sat. $5 buy-in. Loser buys coffee. Place your pick and tiebreaker (exact final score) by 6pm Friday.
Maria: Over 7, put me in. I'll Venmo @maria with $5 later :money_with_wings: 
Jon: Under. Also can we do Venmo to @jon_redwood? :grin: 
Priya: Over — 4-3 Rapids is my tiebreaker.
Sam: Under — 2-1 Cosmos. Wait, are those real teams? :thinking_face: (j/k)
Nora: Over. I'll Venmo @nora and leave a note "office pool".
Alex: Nice. Current entries:
```
Alex: Over (tiebreaker 3-2)
Maria: Over (4-3)
Jon: Under (2-0)
Priya: Over (4-3)
Sam: Under (2-1)
Nora: Over (3-2)
```
Alex: If tie on tiebreaker, highest scoring team in fantasy will be the decider (lol). Poll bot closing at 6pm — shout if you want in after that, we'll make a consolation bracket :sweat_smile:
poll-bot: Poll created — closes Fri 18:00 UTC.
Maria: Also who brings snacks if we stream the game? I volunteer chips :potato:
Jon: I'll bring hot sauce. :fire: 
Priya: Can someone pin the Venmo usernames? I'll send payment screenshot when done.
Alex: Pinned: @maria, @jon_redwood, @nora — I'll collect if anyone wants to hand cash in kitchen.
Sam: Cash accepted. Also who's on halftime karaoke duty? :microphone: 
Nora: Not me. :raising_hand: (no seriously, not me)
Alex: Closing thought — whoever wins gets an office mic drop GIF on the #general channel. Stakes = high.
